You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies a one-variable transition system in which x starts at 0, can move nondeterministically from 0 to either 1 or 2, and from any nonzero value returns to 0. The main specification is an initial condition together with the temporal formula [][Next]_x and a weak fairness condition WF_x(Next), so the behavior is constrained by stuttering-closed next-state evolution plus fairness for Next. The file also states temporal properties about eventually stabilizing away from 1 or 2, eventual repeated return to zero, the negation of one temporal property, and a postcondition that checks a TLC-generated counterexample trace encoded as records, tuples, and sets.
